lines.text: Mia slipped on an icy step and twisted her ankle.
Her partner was out of sight below.
She blew her old whistle. Nothing.
The little ball inside was wet from the morning, and it had frozen stuck.
Carry a whistle with no ball inside, clip it outside on your pack strap, and shake it dry after rain.
Her partner heard her from the switchback.
Save this before your next winter hike.
